name: Disable EEG Channel 3 in OpenBCI GUI
description:
The OpenBCI GUI is running an active Synthetic EEG session showing the Time Series widget with 8 active EEG channels.

Your task is to disable EEG Channel 3:

1. Look at the left edge of the Time Series widget — you will see 8 small colored numbered buttons (circles labeled 1 through 8), one for each EEG channel.
2. Click the button labeled '3' to toggle Channel 3 off. The button will show an 'X' mark when the channel is disabled.
3. After clicking, the Channel 3 waveform in the Time Series widget should become flat (showing zeros), indicating the channel is disabled.

Expected result: Channel 3 in the Time Series display shows a flat line and the channel 3 button shows an 'X' marker.
